gaps.lead: He can't be in Spain — I saw him here this morning.

gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.

it's (high) time + subject + past simple = you should already be doing it.

gaps.lead: It's very unlikely that Martin will win the 100 metres, as he's out of training.
